title: Flatness of finite depth-two extensions on a power-series spectrum
statement: Let $B$ be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], and let $n>0$. Put $T=\operatorname{Spec}(B[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]])$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $V\subset T$ be open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Assume $V$ contains every prime whose contraction along the constant-series inclusion is not $\mathfrak m_B$, and contains the point with prime ideal $\mathfrak m_B B[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$. Let $r:F\to T$ be finite and etale over $V$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Assume every stalk of $F$ at a point mapping outside $V$ has depth at least two. Then $r$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].

source.place: Tag 0EYA; Tag 0EY6(2) uniqueness of depth-two finite extensions; Tag 0337

proof.text: The finitely many variable power-series ring is Noetherian by MvPowerSeries.isNoetherianRing, so its spectrum is locally Noetherian.

Apply exists_finite_etale_extension_of_power_series_open to the finite etale restriction r restricted to V. Obtain E, a finite etale p:E -> T, its boundary depth bound, and e:(p inverse image V) -> (r inverse image V) with e.hom followed by r restricted to V = p restricted to V.
Apply iso_of_finite_depth_two_extensions to the supplied boundary depth of F, the obtained boundary depth of E, and e. It gives an isomorphism i:F -> E satisfying i.hom followed by p = r.
Rewrite r as i.hom followed by p. An isomorphism is flat, an etale morphism is flat, and flat morphisms compose; Mathlib instances therefore prove Flat r.

theorem flat_of_power_series_depth_two_finite_extension
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := B) B)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B))).Opens)
    {F : Scheme.{u}} (r : F ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B)))
    [IsFinite r] [Etale (r ∣_ V)]
    (hboundary : ∀ w : F, r w ∉ V →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk w) (F.presheaf.stalk w))
    (haway : ∀ v, (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin n)))) v ≠
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint B → v ∈ V)
    (hgeneric : ∃ v, v ∈ V ∧ v.asIdeal =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin n))) :
    Flat r
